title: Reference-driven partial sculpt and faithful worn-surface revision
acceptance_criteria: Reference-aligned silhouettes and proportions, recessed dark eyes, central muzzle, padded ears, fitted shoulders and irregular shell damage are faithful to the reference.
Muted worn violet and pale surfaces reproduce the reference character without the previous overly bright grid-like pattern; source-derived texture provenance is retained.
The editable packed Blender scene reopens without missing dependencies, and the produced files match the pinned Release manifest.
Actual front, side, back, face, face-profile and surface views have been inspected against the reference and no major visual defects remain.
